name: Working Across Difference in Social Work

assessments.name: Social Work Action
assessments.description: Students will create a decision case study that demonstrates how social work can proactively respond to diversity using an intersectional lens. The case study should present a complex practice scenario.

assessments.name: Presentation on Racism, Power & Social Work
assessments.description: Students deliver a 10‑minute presentation based on their previously developed decision case study that critically analyses how their chosen case study illustrates structural racism, drawing on critical theories.

assessments.name: Critical Creative Reflection on Racism in Social Work
assessments.description: This assessment requires you to produce a critical creative reflection (or equivalent) that examines how racism operates within a selected field of social work practice.
